pipeline: UnifiedDB canonical typed causal/event stream -> hard deterministic boundary fence -> optional LLM-free semantic subsegmenter -> DerivedMemorySegmentEnvelope (noncanonical) -> typed derived extraction -> deterministic retrieval admission -> semantic ranking -> bounded ContextView -> candidate cognition
key_laws: Derived segment and memory records are rebuildable noncanonical projections linked to exact source-event identities.
Fact/Episode/Method/Process-Policy remain typed separately because their authority/reuse semantics differ.
Memory evolution uses append/supersede/reindex; canonical source events are not destructively rewritten by consolidation.
Deterministic project/task/generation/provenance/capability/domain admission occurs before vector/reranker scoring.
ContextView records selected evidence identities, omissions/budget reasons, provenance and contradictions.

benchmark.decision_rule: Prefer D only if it materially reduces construction cost versus A while matching/improving evidence/provenance correctness and not increasing trust-boundary failures.

next_exact_gate: Separate create-only E3/E4 claim; implement only a deterministic DerivedMemorySegmentEnvelope + hard-boundary fixture/ablation before any full memory service or Trigger4 E5 handoff.
